basic_profile.bio: I'm a 27-year-old graduate student based in Edmonton, Alberta, currently working on my MSc in Biology at the University of Alberta. I have a keen interest in ecology and evolution, which is reflected in my frequent visits to related academic subreddits like r/uAlberta. Outside of academia, I dabble in songwriting and have a nostalgic fondness for Beyblade battles. I'm usually online in the evenings after lab hours, often while sipping on a homemade cup of coffee. I'm single and live with my two cats, who occasionally make appearances in my posts.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a solid foundation in biology from my undergraduate studies, I've expanded my expertise through hands-on research and coursework in ecology and evolutionary biology. My knowledge is further enriched by participating in university-led seminars and online academic forums. I also self-teach through online courses and by engaging with scientific literature.
